invariants.statement: The camera viewpoint is from inside a vehicle, with the dashboard or hood visible at the bottom of the frame.
invariants.evidence: All 8 reference images show the interior dashboard, hood, or windshield wipers at the bottom, confirming a consistent ego-vehicle perspective.

invariants.statement: The drivable road surface occupies the central and lower portion of the image, extending into the distance.
invariants.evidence: In every reference image, the asphalt road is the dominant central element, flanked by curbs, sidewalks, or parked cars.
